label: Extron DTP CrossPoint 82 4K IPCP Q SA (Standard)

_avail.description: 2 x 50 Watt Stereo Amp, AV LAN

ports.label: HDMI In 1
ports.notes: HDMI 1.4, HDCP 1.4. Up to 4K @ 30Hz or UHD/4K @ 60Hz with 4:2:0 chroma subsampling. De-embedded audio (PCM only) feeds the audio matrix; multi-channel bitstream formats (Dolby Atmos, DTS-HD, etc.) pass through to HDMI outputs untouched.

ports.label: DTP In 7
ports.notes: Configurable DTP or XTP RJ-45 input. DTP carries HDMI + embedded audio + analog audio + RS-232 + IR + remote power up to 330ft (100m) on shielded CATx; XTP mode adds digital embedded audio (no remote power). Shielded twisted pair required.

ports.label: DTP In 8
ports.notes: Configurable DTP or XTP RJ-45 input. DTP carries HDMI + embedded audio + analog audio + RS-232 + IR + remote power up to 330ft (100m) on shielded CATx; XTP mode adds digital embedded audio (no remote power). Shielded twisted pair required.

ports.label: HDMI Out 1A
ports.notes: Buffered HDMI mirror of a scaled DTP output, for local monitoring. Same routing as the paired RJ-45 output (typically scaled outputs 5 and 6 in the panel labeling).; buffered mirror

ports.label: HDMI Out 2A
ports.notes: Buffered HDMI mirror of a scaled DTP output, for local monitoring. Same routing as the paired RJ-45 output (typically scaled outputs 5 and 6 in the panel labeling).; buffered mirror

ports.label: DTP Out 1B
ports.notes: Configurable DTP / XTP / HDBaseT output with Vector 4K seamless scaling. Carries HDMI + embedded audio + bidirectional RS-232 + IR over shielded CATx (DTP/XTP up to 330ft, HDBT mode up to 330ft).

ports.label: DTP Out 2B
ports.notes: Configurable DTP / XTP / HDBaseT output with Vector 4K seamless scaling. Carries HDMI + embedded audio + bidirectional RS-232 + IR over shielded CATx (DTP/XTP up to 330ft, HDBT mode up to 330ft).

ports.label: Audio In 1
ports.notes: Stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. +4dBu nominal, +21dBu max balanced. -18 to +24 dB input gain.

ports.label: Audio In 2
ports.notes: Stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. +4dBu nominal, +21dBu max balanced. -18 to +24 dB input gain.

ports.label: Audio In 3
ports.notes: Stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. +4dBu nominal, +21dBu max balanced. -18 to +24 dB input gain.

ports.label: Audio In 4
ports.notes: Stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. +4dBu nominal, +21dBu max balanced. -18 to +24 dB input gain.

ports.label: Audio In 5
ports.notes: Stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. +4dBu nominal, +21dBu max balanced. -18 to +24 dB input gain.

ports.label: Audio In 6
ports.notes: Stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. +4dBu nominal, +21dBu max balanced. -18 to +24 dB input gain.

ports.label: Mic/Line In 1
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 3-pole captive screw. -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +80 dB input gain. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: Mic/Line In 2
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 3-pole captive screw. -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +80 dB input gain. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: Mic/Line In 3
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 3-pole captive screw. -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +80 dB input gain. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: Mic/Line In 4
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 3-pole captive screw. -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +80 dB input gain. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: S/PDIF Out 2
ports.notes: S/PDIF digital audio output on coaxial RCA. 75 ohm impedance.

ports.label: Audio Out 1
ports.notes: Variable stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. >+21 dBu max balanced, +15 dBu max unbalanced.

ports.label: Audio Out 2
ports.notes: Variable stereo balanced/unbalanced analog line-level output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. >+21 dBu max balanced, +15 dBu max unbalanced.

ports.label: Speaker Out
ports.notes: Class D stereo amplifier output. 25W rms per channel into 8Ω, 50W rms per channel into 4Ω. 5mm 4-pole captive screw shared with the other channel (L+/L-/R+/R-). Per-channel modeled. (L/R; 4-pole captive screw)

ports.label: AV LAN 1 1
ports.notes: 10/100Base-T half/full-duplex Ethernet for switcher control + web UI + SIS protocol. Default 192.168.254.254. Independent from the IPCP control processor's Ethernet ports.

ports.label: AV LAN 2 2
ports.notes: 10/100/1000Base-T network switch port on the integrated IPCP Pro xi control processor. 3-port unmanaged switch (LAN + 2x AV LAN). Default 192.168.254.250.

ports.label: AV LAN 3 3
ports.notes: 10/100/1000Base-T network switch port on the integrated IPCP Pro xi control processor. 3-port unmanaged switch (LAN + 2x AV LAN). Default 192.168.254.250.

ports.label: LAN
ports.notes: 10/100/1000Base-T network switch port on the integrated IPCP Pro xi control processor. 3-port unmanaged switch (LAN + 2x AV LAN). Default 192.168.254.250.

ports.label: RS-232/IR (In 7)
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 control for the switcher matrix on 3.5mm 3-pole captive screw. 9600-115200 baud. Independent from any IPCP control-processor serial ports. (RS-232 and IR on one connector; 5-pole captive screw)

ports.label: RS-232/IR (In 8)
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote source-side endpoints). Pin 1=Tx, 2=Rx, 3=Gnd. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching IR pass-thru port (pins 4-5). (RS-232 and IR on one connector; 5-pole captive screw)

ports.label: RS-232/IR (Out 1B)
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote source-side endpoints). Pin 1=Tx, 2=Rx, 3=Gnd. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching IR pass-thru port (pins 4-5). (RS-232 and IR on one connector; 5-pole captive screw)

ports.label: RS-232/IR (Out 2B)
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote sink-side endpoints). Pin 1=Tx, 2=Rx, 3=Gnd. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching IR pass-thru port (pins 4-5). (RS-232 and IR on one connector; 5-pole captive screw)

ports.label: COM 1
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 over the DTP/XTP/HDBT TP link (to remote sink-side endpoints). Pin 1=Tx, 2=Rx, 3=Gnd. Shares the same 5-pole captive with the matching IR pass-thru port (pins 4-5). (5-pole captive screw)

ports.label: COM 2
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 / RS-422 / RS-485 (software-selectable) on 3.5mm 5-pole captive. Hardware + software flow control. 300-115200 baud. (3-pole captive screw)

ports.label: COM 3
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 on 3.5mm 3-pole captive. Software flow control. 300-115200 baud. (3-pole captive screw)

ports.label: RS-232
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 on 3.5mm 3-pole captive. Software flow control. 300-115200 baud. (3-pole captive screw)

ports.label: IR/S Out 1
ports.notes: Programmable IR (carrier or non-carrier, 30-300kHz) or unidirectional RS-232 ±5V output on 3.5mm captive. Per-channel modeled — both ports share a single 5-pole captive screw block. (IR or one-way RS-232; 2-pole captive screw)

ports.label: IR/S Out 2
ports.notes: Programmable IR (carrier or non-carrier, 30-300kHz) or unidirectional RS-232 ±5V output on 3.5mm captive. Per-channel modeled — both ports share a single 5-pole captive screw block. (IR or one-way RS-232; 2-pole captive screw)

ports.label: Relay 1
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1A max) on 3.5mm 6-pole captive. Per-channel modeled — 4 relays share a single 6-pole captive. (3-pole captive screw)

ports.label: Relay 2
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1A max) on 3.5mm 6-pole captive. Per-channel modeled — 4 relays share a single 6-pole captive.

ports.label: Relay 3
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1A max) on 3.5mm 6-pole captive. Per-channel modeled — 4 relays share a single 6-pole captive. (3-pole captive screw)

ports.label: Relay 4
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1A max) on 3.5mm 6-pole captive. Per-channel modeled — 4 relays share a single 6-pole captive.

ports.label: Digital I/O 1
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive. Input: 0-24 VDC, 29kΩ impedance, programmable 1kΩ pullup to +5V. Output: 250mA sink from 24V max. Per-channel modeled — 4 channels share a single 5-pole captive.

ports.label: Digital I/O 2
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive. Input: 0-24 VDC, 29kΩ impedance, programmable 1kΩ pullup to +5V. Output: 250mA sink from 24V max. Per-channel modeled — 4 channels share a single 5-pole captive.

ports.label: Digital I/O 3
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive. Input: 0-24 VDC, 29kΩ impedance, programmable 1kΩ pullup to +5V. Output: 250mA sink from 24V max. Per-channel modeled — 4 channels share a single 5-pole captive.

ports.label: Digital I/O 4
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive. Input: 0-24 VDC, 29kΩ impedance, programmable 1kΩ pullup to +5V. Output: 250mA sink from 24V max. Per-channel modeled — 4 channels share a single 5-pole captive.

ports.label: EXP
ports.notes: Extron proprietary EXP audio expansion bus on RJ-45. 16ch Tx + 16ch Rx, 24-bit/48kHz uncompressed. Links a second Extron DSP for I/O expansion. Shielded CAT 6 up to 10m. Modeled as `aes` + `rj45` per project convention (no `extron-exp` SignalType).

ports.label: eBUS
ports.notes: 5-pole captive screw

ports.label: USB (Front)
ports.notes: Front-panel USB Mini-B for direct switcher configuration via PC. USB 2.0 low speed.

ports.label: Power
ports.notes: Internal universal-input PSU. 100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, IEC C14 inlet.
